Mars is not waiting for one discipline at a time. Every meaningful surface system couples science, physical engineering, operations and human survival. The thesis tonight is simple: the next leap is not a larger chatbot. It is an intelligence layer—a governed way for people, AI models, solvers, instruments and robots to work through evidence, design, verification and learning as one system.

We need persistent memory, explicit work products, traceable handoffs and gates that stronger future intelligence can inherit. The goal is faster learning without counterfeit certainty.

## Slide 2: Mars is a learning-rate problem

**Section:** 02 / MISSION CONSTRAINT  
**Planned timing:** 1:15

### On-slide text

- 02 / MISSION CONSTRAINT
- Mars is a learning-rate problem
- The scarcest resource is time - from a goal to execution. The critical path is having validated science, using the scientific principles for engineering design and executing the physical implementation of the goal
- Understand the science needed
- Design a solution
- Build the physical reality
- TEST & VERIFY
- Research And Development
- Proejct Managment
- A Ai agentic harness attacks coordination latency while preserving the evidence needed to close decisions.
- MARS SOCIETY 2026 • HARNESSED AGENTIC SCIENCE + ENGINEERING
- BOB J MILLS 02

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:15]

Frame the problem as learning latency, not merely compute. Mars teams must turn uncertain observations into defensible action while mass, power, schedule and crew margins keep closing. That requires literature search, data grounding, hypothesis testing, multidisciplinary analysis, review, documentation and physical verification to move as a connected loop.

Communications delay makes the problem visible. NASA’s Moon-to-Mars analysis finds one-way delays can reach roughly twenty-one to twenty-three minutes, with representative blackout periods lasting about thirteen to twenty-one days. Earth cannot remain the synchronous brain for every decision. The same constraint appears before launch: science and engineering teams lose time at handoffs, review preparation and rediscovery of prior reasoning.

Agentic harnesses do not make physics instantaneous. They compress avoidable waiting by running controlled work in parallel, carrying evidence forward and surfacing broken links early.

This is the architectural definition. A model is the engine; the harness is the infrastructure surrounding it. That infrastructure is the difference between describing a task and completing it with evidence and accountable control.

Walk the seven functions: first, the orchestration loop that plans, executes, inspects and repairs. Second, system instructions that define role and purpose. Third, tool access. The model can change without breaking the process because work-product contracts, ground-truth checks, durable state and authority remain stable. This is why harness design can matter more than the model itself.

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:15]

Named agents are useful for implementation, but they are a fragile architecture. The durable map is the set of capabilities and the evidence each capability must produce. Scientific reasoning, literature grounding, simulation, systems engineering, CAD, FMEA, test planning and governance are skills. A person, model, database, solver, robot or future AGI can perform a skill if it satisfies the contract.

This matters on Mars because the executor changes with context. During communications delay, a local model may act. For a nonlinear trade, a deterministic solver should act. For a physical claim, an instrument or chamber test must act. For risk acceptance, authorized mission leadership must act.

Skills over agents prevents tool worship. It also makes the handoff auditable: the next stage receives an approved work product, not merely the opinion of a named digital persona.

## Slide 5: Three harnesses. One digital thread.

**Section:** 05 / SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE  
**Planned timing:** 1:15

### On-slide text

- 05 / SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
- Three harnesses. One digital thread.

- HYPATIA PRO SCIENCE HARNESS
- INTELLIGENT ENGINEER HARNESS
- VERIFY • MANUFACTURE • OPERATE
- APPROVED EVIDENCE →
- Field and test evidence can reopen the science—or the design.

- BOB J MILLS 05
- PROECT MANAGEMENT HARNESS

- RESEARCH TO UNDERSTAND • APPLY UNDERSTANDING TO DESIGN
- HYPATIA PRO SCIENCE HARNESS
- INTELLIGENT ENGINEER HARNESS

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:15]

The architecture uses two connected harnesses because science and engineering have different jobs. Hypatia Pro asks what is supported, uncertain or unresolved. Intelligent Engineer Pro asks how to build within that evidence, how to control risk and how to prove the result.

The forward handoff is an Engineering Evidence Package: equations, distributions, operating envelopes, provenance, assumptions, failure thresholds and minimum additional tests. The return handoff is a Research Request Package: a blocked decision, competing hypotheses, variables, Mars boundary conditions, method and acceptance threshold.

That return path is essential. It turns “we need more research” into a bounded job that can be executed and reinserted into the same baseline. Verification, manufacturing and operations then generate new evidence. The digital thread keeps the loop continuous across tools, people and future model generations.

## Slide 6: Hypatia turns curiosity into defensible science

**Section:** 06 / SCIENCE HARNESS  
**Planned timing:** 1:20

### On-slide text

- 06 / SCIENCE HARNESS
- Hypatia turns curiosity into defensible science
- Falsifiable questions. Explicit variables. Classified evidence. Adversarial attack. Automated Science with Human in the loop
- REFINE
- research question
- GROUND
- literature + data
- PREDICT
- competing hypotheses
- MEASURE
- experiment / simulation
- ATTACK
- peer critique + refutation
- SYNTHESIZE
- approved result
- GENERATE → VALIDATE → CRITIQUE REPAIR → APPROVE → PERSIST
- ONLY APPROVED OUTPUTS FLOW FORWARD
- MARS SOCIETY 2026 • HARNESSED AGENTIC SCIENCE + ENGINEERING
- BOB J MILLS 06

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:20]

Hypatia is a scientific-discovery harness, not a fluent literature summarizer. It refines the question, grounds it in prior evidence, generates falsifiable competing hypotheses, defines variables and measurement protocols, obtains evidence, quantifies uncertainty and invites adversarial attack.

The governing loop is generate, validate, critique, repair, approve and persist. A model may draft an artifact, but drafting is not promotion. The artifact must survive checks appropriate to its class. A literature claim needs a traceable source. A simulated result needs a model, assumptions and boundary conditions. An empirical claim needs measurement provenance. A failed hypothesis is preserved because negative evidence is part of mission knowledge.

The loop can move backward whenever grounding, protocol or inference is weak. That willingness to refuse premature certainty is what makes the output safe enough to become an engineering input.

## Slide 7: Every claim carries epistemic status

**Section:** 07 / EVIDENCE CONTROL  
**Planned timing:** 1:20

### On-slide text

- 07 / EVIDENCE CONTROL
- Every claim carries epistemic status
- The harness prevents a plausible sentence—or a clean simulation—from silently becoming a physical fact.
- LITERATURE
- what has been reported
- SOURCE + SCOPE
- MODELED
- what the equations predict
- ASSUMPTIONS + BOUNDS
- EMPIRICAL
- what was physically measured
- METHOD + UNCERTAINTY
- OPEN
- what remains unresolved
- QUESTION + DISPOSITION
- NO SILENT PROMOTION
- CLAIM WITH STATUS
- Literature informs models. Models guide tests. Tests may revise both. Open questions stay open.
- MARS SOCIETY 2026 • HARNESSED AGENTIC SCIENCE + ENGINEERING
- BOB J MILLS 07

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:20]

A mission loses integrity when evidence classes blur. Literature can be authoritative within its scope, but it is not automatically valid at a different pressure, temperature, material or scale. A model can be useful and still be wrong outside its assumptions. A physical measurement can be real and still have uncertainty or limited transferability. An unresolved question is not a defect to hide; it is a work item.

The harness attaches status to the claim itself. It also carries source, scope, assumptions, boundary conditions, measurement method, uncertainty and disposition. That allows engineering to use knowledge without pretending it is stronger than it is.

This is especially important in AI-generated work. Fluency can erase the visual cues that used to warn us an answer was tentative. Explicit epistemic status puts those cues back into the engineering record and lets later evidence reopen affected requirements and decisions.

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:20]

Intelligent Engineer Pro takes an approved evidence package and converts it into requirements, architecture alternatives, margins, design analyses, risks, verification methods and controlled review artifacts. It is phase-gated because a fast draft must not become an invisible baseline.

The harness supports project definition, requirements and constraints, discipline selection, preliminary and critical design, focused design sprints, multidisciplinary analysis, CAD, FEA, CFD, circuit and process work, DFMA, FMEA, redundancy, manufacturing, maintenance and operations planning. It can generate next-phase seeds, but those seeds remain drafts until reviewed.

The important distinction is authorization. A model can propose a requirement or design. The project records what evidence supports it, what assumptions remain, what test will verify it and what authority locks it. That discipline lets automation accelerate engineering without smuggling unreviewed content into the next phase.

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:20]

The handoff between science and engineering cannot be a prose answer. Engineering needs a structured evidence package containing equations, parameter distributions, operating envelopes, assumptions, failure thresholds, confidence, provenance and the tests still required.

Each element is linked. A source supports a bounded claim. The claim defines a parameter or constraint. The parameter supports a requirement or trade. The requirement has a verification method and status. When evidence changes, the digital thread identifies exactly which requirement, model, test or decision is affected.

This is where a harness becomes more than workflow automation. It creates machine-readable contracts between disciplines. It allows agents to maintain traceability, detect inconsistencies and reopen focused work before a review. The result is less time reconstructing intent and more time resolving the actual engineering question.

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:20]

A linear research-to-engineering arrow is incomplete. The real acceleration comes from closing the return path. Research delivers approved evidence. Engineering turns it into requirements and trades. Design or analysis exposes a blocking uncertainty. The harness packages that uncertainty as a precise research request. Targeted evidence returns to the same baseline, the affected decision is updated and engineering continues.

Agents can search, simulate, critique, document and maintain links throughout the loop. The key is that they do not erase the issue. They make it explicit and executable. A good Research Request Package names the blocked decision, hypotheses, variables, Mars boundary conditions, method, minimum detectable effect, evidence quality and acceptance threshold.

Verification, manufacturing and operations remain part of the same learning system. A failed test or field observation can reopen science, requirements or design without losing the chain of reasoning.

## Slide 11: Parallel work shortens waiting; gates preserve truth

**Section:** 11 / AGENTIC ACCELERATION  
**Planned timing:** 1:10

### On-slide text

- 11 / AGENTIC ACCELERATION
- Parallel work shortens waiting; gates preserve truth
- The harness coordinates independent searches, analyses and critiques—then merges only reviewed work.
- MISSION QUESTION
- EVIDENCE SEARCH
- sources • conflicts • gaps
- MODELS + TRADES
- simulation • sensitivity
- ADVERSARIAL ATTACK
- failure • counterexample
- ARTIFACT BUILD
- trace • report • review pack
- VALIDATE CRITIQUE APPROVE
- ONE REVIEWED PACKAGE
- SEQUENTIAL
- HARNESS
- same evidence standard • less avoidable waiting
- MARS SOCIETY 2026 • HARNESSED AGENTIC SCIENCE + ENGINEERING
- BOB J MILLS 11

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:10]

Parallelism is where agentic systems can attack real schedule. One workstream searches evidence and contradictions. Another runs models and sensitivity studies. Another tries to break the preferred conclusion. Another builds traceable artifacts and review material. These tasks can overlap when their interfaces and permissions are defined.

The merge gate matters more than the number of agents. Independent outputs must be reconciled, validated, critiqued and approved before they become one package. Parallel work should not create four incompatible truths or hide duplicated assumptions. The harness records dependencies, evidence classes and unresolved conflicts.

The result is not “AI worked four times faster.” The defensible claim is narrower: controlled concurrency reduces avoidable waiting and review preparation while preserving the evidence standard. That is a practical way to compress the research–engineering–research issue–completion loop.

## Slide 12: Verification starts at the first claim

**Planned timing:** 1:10

- dust fouling dominates

- literature + model
- REQUIREMENT
- recover performance

- Every uncertainty gets a disposition
- ANALYZE

- BOB J MILLS 12

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:10]

Verification is not the last phase. It begins with the first claim. Every claim needs provenance. Every requirement needs a method. Every uncertainty needs a disposition: analyze it, test it, constrain the design around it or explicitly accept the risk.

A harness can maintain the trace matrix continuously. It can identify a source that no longer supports its claim, a changed parameter that invalidates a requirement, a requirement without a method or a test result that does not meet its acceptance criterion. That broken link becomes focused rework before the review, not a surprise during it.

AI can help generate tests, check consistency, update FMEA and organize evidence. It cannot claim that a simulation physically validated hardware. Verification is the discipline that separates an impressive demonstration from engineering that can be trusted on Mars.

## Slide 14: MOXIE proved the chemistry. This modeled scenario tests a settlement-scale oxygen mission.

**Section:** 14 / CASE STUDY — MISSION SCENARIO  
**Planned timing:** 2:00

### On-slide text

- 14 / CASE STUDY — MISSION SCENARIO
- MOXIE proved the chemistry. This modeled scenario tests a settlement-scale oxygen mission.
- SCALED MOXIE
- Modeled continuous power
- Modeled O₂ over 730 days
- MOXIE demonstrated purity
- Modeled O₂ allocation, tonnes
- MARS SOCIETY 2026 • HARNESSED AGENTIC SCIENCE + ENGINEERING
- BOB J MILLS 14
- 304 kWe*
- 592 t*
- ≥98%

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 2:00]

This is the mission scenario used to test the connected harnesses. NASA MOXIE is the empirical anchor: it demonstrated solid-oxide carbon-dioxide electrolysis on Mars and reported oxygen purity of at least 98 percent. The settlement-scale figures on this slide are modeled scenario outputs, not NASA-qualified performance.

The scenario assumes 592 tonnes of oxygen over 730 days. The calculation is 592,000 kilograms divided by 17,520 hours, which equals 33.79 kilograms per hour average. The displayed allocation is approximately 585 tonnes for the return-vehicle scenario and 7.4 tonnes for a 12-person crew. The crew value corresponds to roughly 0.845 kilograms per person per day. The 304 kWe figure is the concept-level continuous power estimate produced by the demonstration and requires subsystem-level verification.

The purpose is to show what the harnesses do with an ambitious target: Hypatia tests scientific plausibility and uncertainties; engineering creates a controlled concept; project management turns that concept into work, resources, cost, schedule and tracking.

[Sources]
- https://www.nasa.gov/missions/mars-2020-perseverance/perseverance-rover/nasas-oxygen-generating-experiment-moxie-completes-mars-mission/
- Project ARES-SOE demonstration output supplied by Bob J Mills.
- Calculation: 592,000 kg / (730 days × 24 h/day) = 33.79 kg/h.
- Calculation: 7,400 kg / (12 people × 730 days) = 0.845 kg/person/day.

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:40]

The engineering harness translates the reviewed science package into a controlled physical-system concept. The visible phases cover feasibility, requirements, preliminary design, critical design, testing, launch, operations and improvement. The example excerpt focuses on vibration monitoring and structural integrity for compressors and rotating equipment.

Terminology matters: SOXE means solid-oxide electrolysis—here, solid-oxide carbon-dioxide electrolysis. The 33.8 kilogram-per-hour production rate and 304 kWe power budget are modeled scenario values. They must remain linked to assumptions, margins and verification methods rather than being presented as demonstrated plant performance.

Engineering must integrate atmospheric acquisition, filtration, compression, electrolysis stacks, heat recovery, oxygen cleanup, liquefaction, storage, transfer, power, autonomy, redundancy and maintainability. Every requirement should identify its supporting evidence, responsible owner, verification method and release authority.

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 2:00]

This is the central case-study result. Agentic harnesses can create and connect a first-pass research, engineering and project package in hours. That compression applies to searching, drafting, calculating, coordinating, critiquing, traceability and change propagation. It does not eliminate the time required for experiments, hardware development, long-duration testing, independent review or mission qualification.

Each stage has its own work-product contract. Science produces classified evidence and open questions. Engineering produces requirements, trades, designs and verification methods. Project management produces scope, resources, schedule, cost, risks and controls. Approved context moves forward; blocking uncertainties return as bounded research requests.

AI-driven change management can identify affected documents and rerun dependent analyses, but humans retain approval and risk authority. Every step may operate with substantial autonomy or pause for manual review and editing.

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:30]

The case study yields five conclusions in each discipline. Science finds scale-up plausible but keeps modeled values, degradation and experiments explicit. Engineering finds that system integration, power, traceability, reliability and the return of blockers dominate the real design problem. Project execution finds that the WBS, estimate basis, risks, change state and approval gates determine whether the concept can become controlled work.

The shared lesson is simple: the harness compresses disciplined concept development. It does not promote a draft into physical truth. Readiness still depends on evidence, testing, independent review and authorized acceptance.

## Slide 21: Start with one consequential loop

**Section:** 21 / ADOPTION  
**Planned timing:** 1:40

### On-slide text

- 21 / ADOPTION
- Start with one consequential loop
- Prove traceability and expert equivalence on a recurring decision before attempting an enterprise-wide ecosystem.
- 1
- SELECT
- One goal for development
- 2
- DEFINE
- work products + evidence classes Define the goal the best you can and provide as much supporting information as you have.
- 3
- APPLY
- Use the best harness you have available and then give it a set of aerospace specific science and engineer skills and agents. and mission memory
- 4
- VALIDATE
- expert baseline + failed cases. Use Human in the loop and review the results regenerate results where needed.
- 5
- DEPLOY
- Use Ai Driven Project Planning using the work product from the validated design results. Then Deploy per the plan and use Ai to look for risk, track progress and predict blockers.
- FIRST WIN
- One high-value learning loop with evidence that survives review.
- When you have blockers in the design or deploy phase go back to first principles and use the science harness to find solutions.
- MARS SOCIETY 2026 • HARNESSED AGENTIC SCIENCE + ENGINEERING
- BOB J MILLS 21

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:40]

The practical starting point is not an enterprise transformation. Choose one recurring decision where delay, rework or lost evidence matters. Define the required work products, evidence classes, tools, permissions, validation steps and release authority. Connect only the data and tools needed for that loop.

Then compare the harness output against expert work and known failure cases. Can it preserve provenance? Does it distinguish modeled from empirical evidence? Does it expose uncertainty? Can a reviewer reconstruct the decision? Does it fail safely when the evidence is inadequate?

Only after that loop survives real pressure should the organization scale to adjacent skills and domains. Most organizations are still moving from chatbot to task agent. The practical next stage is the harness: workflow, memory, tools and gates. Mars-scale learning eventually requires an ecosystem, but reliability is earned one consequential loop at a time.

## Slide 22: MAKE ENGINEERING A LEARNING SYSTEM

**Section:** 22 / CALL TO ACTION  
**Planned timing:** 1:40

### On-slide text

- 22 / CALL TO ACTION
- MAKE ENGINEERING A LEARNING SYSTEM
- Mars will reward teams that learn faster without losing discipline.
- SCIENCE
- ENGINEERING
- Build the intelligence layer now—so every stronger model inherits a mission-ready way to work.
- MARS SOCIETY 2026 • HARNESSED AGENTIC SCIENCE + ENGINEERING
- BOB J MILLS 22
- More SCIENCE to address engineering blockers
- More ENGINEERING in a loop
- PROECT MANAGED EXECUTION
- OPERATIONS

### Speaker notes

[Timing: 1:40]

Return to the opening promise. Mars is a learning-rate problem, but speed without discipline is not progress. The architecture presented here turns AI into structured engineering capacity: specialized harnesses, durable skills, explicit evidence classes, phase gates, continuous verification, persistent mission memory and a complete return path from engineering uncertainty to targeted science.

The model is replaceable. The way the mission defines work, remembers evidence, accepts risk and proves a result must endure. Stronger AI will move more execution into automation. That makes the harness more important, not less, because purpose, authority, provenance and acceptance must remain visible as capability changes.

Start with one consequential loop. Make the evidence survive review. Preserve negative results. Let science refuse false certainty. Let engineering return precise questions. Then connect the loops until science, engineering, verification and operations become one learning system.

Mars will not be built by a chatbot. It will be built by people and increasingly capable intelligence working through a mission-ready way to learn.
